BiblicalUsage: Strength here is the strong hand that brings Israel out of Egypt, and Moses tells the people to remember it every year. Amos turns the word against those who boast in their own strength, taking a thing of nothing and calling it power. Haggai promises that God will overthrow the strength of kingdoms.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe strength belongs to God first, and every human claim on it is borrowed. The Exodus proves it: Israel did not break its own chains. My position is that boasting in our own strength is the surest way to lose it, because God gives strength to the humble and takes it from the proud.
